settings.heading: From a few cells to a plant
settings.text: Propagation in a laboratory instead of a greenhouse. It is how most rare aroids are multiplied today.

settings.title: A few cells
settings.text: Taken from a healthy parent and sterilised. No pests, no disease, no soil.

settings.title: Sealed and sterile
settings.text: Grown on nutrient gel in constant warmth, near 100% humidity.

settings.title: Multiplied, true to type
settings.text: Many identical plantlets, each genetically the parent. Variegation included.

settings.title: Rooted and shipped to us
settings.text: In sealed, labelled containers. They have never seen open air, so they need a gentle start at yours.

settings.heading: Pre-order, or ready to ship
settings.text: Same plant, different point in its journey. You pick the stage on the product page.

settings.title: Pre-order
settings.text: Reserved from the next lab batch. Price locked when you order; ships two to three weeks after the cut-off.

settings.title: Ready to ship
settings.text: Already here, rooted and acclimated by us. The quickest way to a plant on your shelf.

settings.title: Mature specimens
settings.text: Established, larger plants. Each listing is one plant, photographed as it is.

settings.heading: Your pre-order journey
settings.text: Early orders get the best batch price and the front of the queue.

settings.title: Order placed
settings.text: Your price is held until the plant ships.

settings.title: Cut-off date
settings.text: The batch closes and we order from the lab. Later orders join the next batch.

settings.title: Lab confirms
settings.text: If a variety can’t be supplied, you choose a full refund or a swap of equal value.

settings.title: Arrival and inspection
settings.text: Plants land in Canada and are checked by us before packing.

settings.title: Delivered to you
settings.text: Tracked, early in the week. About two to three weeks after the cut-off.

settings.heading: What arrives, and how to settle it in
settings.text: A small plantlet with roots but no soil, used to 100% humidity. Easing it down to room air is called acclimation, and it is everything.

settings.text: Ten steps from unboxing to a potted plant.

settings.title: Starter kit
settings.text: Everything the guide asks for, added to your cart at no charge.

settings.heading: Every plant is covered for 30 days
settings.text: If a plant doesn’t pull through within 30 days of delivery, we replace it. One condition: a photo the day it arrives.

settings.title: 30-Day Plant Guarantee
settings.text: What’s covered and how to claim. Dead on arrival within 24 hours is a separate, better route: a full refund.

settings.heading: Shipping, simply
settings.text: Tracked, Canada only, no P.O. boxes. In extreme weather we hold a parcel rather than freeze it.

settings.heading: The honest small print
settings.text: True of every live plant. Tap a question.

settings.question: Will my plant look like the photo?
settings.answer: Each plant is its own plant. Size, leaf count and variegation vary, photos are examples, and plantlets arrive small.

settings.question: Is variegation guaranteed?
settings.answer: Tissue culture keeps the parent’s genetics, but variegation shifts with conditions and time. Not guaranteed unless a listing says so.

settings.question: A leaf is yellow or bent after shipping. Is something wrong?
settings.answer: Usually not. A little yellowing or a bent leaf is normal shipping stress while new growth keeps coming. Photograph it on arrival anyway.

settings.question: Are the plants pest-free?
settings.answer: Tissue culture is sterile and we inspect every plant. A short quarantine from your other plants is still wise.

settings.question: Can I cancel a pre-order?
settings.answer: Pre-orders, no: the lab has already been paid for your plant. Ready-to-ship orders, yes, any time before they ship.

settings.question: Who is AgaPlantz?
settings.answer: A small Canadian shop in Brampton, Ontario, grown out of a personal collection of rare aroids. Most of it is tissue culture, acclimated here first.
